 Hoffenheim v OL: first call-up for Angel Garcia, Pavel Sulc out 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Paulo Fonseca will be without Czech attacker Pavel Sulc and Nicolas Tagliafico for OL’s Europa League trip to Hoffenheim , while young full-back Angel Garcia receives his first call-up.
 According to Le Progres, a 23-man squad travelled to Germany on Wednesday for the third matchday, with kick-off on Thursday at 21:00.
 OneFootball Videos
 The morning session in Décines featured the Argentine defender working with a fitness coach. He remains short of full fitness and has not made the trip.
 Sulc, used as a forward for the team, scored in the last two matches against Crystal Palace and Nice. Fonseca should clarify at his press conference whether the decision is precautionary before PSG on Sunday, or a more serious issue.
 The coach otherwise has his group available, aside from Mohamed Ouedraogo, who recently had surgery on a ruptured right ACL, and Loïs Openda, who sustained a fibula problem at Lens on 9 October.
 He has also called up defenders Steeve Kango and Noham Kamara, along with Garcia, who signed his first professional contract in March.
 The OL group: Greif, Descamps, Bengui - Athekame, Abner, Niakhaté, Bacher, Kluivert, Mata, Kango, Garcia, Kamara - Bidstrup, Tessmann, Tolisso, Merah, Morton, Nartey - Nuamah, Nakamura, Duranville, Boudache, Himbert.
 Source: Le Progres
